body: P2. cps/user_library.py:345-346 returns no work when status enabled, but per-account exceptions still reach final status enabled at395. Inject transient seed failure; retry after restoring seed routine returns [] and leaves reader monolibrary. A real seed commit then ordinary exception can persist browse_global=True while mode=False despite rollback. UI reports errors but offers only Undo/Close, not retry. Undo then enable is a workaround. Need resumable partial operation preserving original snapshot and retrying only failures. Independent in-memory and file-backed SQLite probes confirmed. Main1ec1bfe677 audit2026-09-08.

resolution.note: Fixed by durable incomplete status, pending/failed account payload and retry of incomplete entries only, preserving completed curated selections. Partial failure before/after seed commit and partial Undo tests green; original recovery tests seen red on 1c4f7c52ab. Parent UI integration consumes new retry state.

title: My Library bulk enable records completion despite failed accounts and cannot retry them
